_instructions: This file maps each movable treasure tile to a closeup photo you provide.
HOW TO ADD YOUR TILE PHOTOS:
1. Take a closeup photo of each treasure tile (any angle, any lighting).
2. Name the file exactly as shown in the 'image' field below.
3. Place all tile photos in the folder:  public/tile-templates/
(create the folder if it doesn't exist)
4. Save this file — the app picks up the changes on next reload.
PHOTO TIPS:
- Frame the tile so it fills most of the photo (no need to crop precisely).
- The app automatically crops the center 60% of each photo for icon matching,
so a bit of wall/border showing around the edges is fine.
- One photo per treasure is enough. Rotation doesn't matter for matching.
- Any common format works: JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP.
FIELDS:
treasure_id : must match exactly one of the valid IDs listed below
image       : filename inside public/tile-templates/ (include extension)
shape       : the tile's corridor shape — 'corner' | 't-junction'
(straight tiles have no treasure in this game)
note        : free-text reminder for yourself, not used by the app
enabled     : set to false to skip this tile during matching (e.g. if photo is unclear)
VALID TREASURE IDs:
Corner-shaped tiles  : lizard, moth, owl, scarab, rat, spider
T-junction tiles     : bat, dragon, ghost_bottle, ghost_waving, lady_pig, sorceress

tile_templates.note: Ghost (waving) — ghost with ball and chain
Lady Pig — upside-down jester / clown figure
